question:
After interchanging which two numbers will the value of the given expression be‘173’?

52 – 36 + 141 × 63 ÷ 47
solution:
Given equation: 52 – 36 + 141 × 63 ÷ 47.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 141 and 52

Given: 52 – 36 + 141 × 63 ÷ 47.

After interchanging the Numbers we get;

⇒ 141 – 36 + 52 × __**63 ÷ 47**__

⇒ 141 – 36 + __**52 × 1.34**__

⇒ __**141**__ – 36 __**+ 69.68**__

⇒ __210.68 - 36__

⇒ 174.68 ≠ 173

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 47 and 63
